tool.name: Evo 2
tool.description: DNA foundation model - 40B parameters for genome-scale analysis
tool.command: echo '$sequence' > input_seq.txt && python '$__tool_directory__/scripts/evo2_wrapper.py' --mode generate --model evo2_7b --input input_seq.txt --output '$output' --n_tokens $num_tokens --temperature $temperature

param.name: sequence
param.label: Input DNA sequence
param.help: DNA sequence using A, T, C, G characters. Supports up to 1M base pairs.

param.name: num_tokens
param.label: Tokens to generate
param.help: Number of DNA bases to generate (for generation task)

param.name: context_length
param.label: Context length
param.help: Maximum context window. Model supports up to 1M bp.

tool.help:
**Evo 2: 40 Billion Parameter DNA Foundation Model**
Arc Institute's largest DNA model, trained on 9 trillion nucleotides from 100,000+ species.
**Hardware Requirements:** - GPU Memory: ~80 GB (runs on NVIDIA GB10 with 120GB unified memory) - Disk Space: ~80 GB for model weights
**Capabilities:** - Generate DNA sequence continuations - Score sequence likelihood - Extract learned embeddings - Predict variant effects - Supports 1 million base pair context
**Tasks:** - **Generation**: Continue a DNA sequence - **Scoring**: Calculate sequence likelihood - **Embedding**: Extract vector representations - **Variant Effect**: Predict mutation impact
**Citation:** Arc Institute (2025). Evo 2: A 40 billion parameter DNA foundation model.
